About.title: About me
About.lead: I'm Monika, an <specialist>AI Visual Director</specialist> creating high-end commercials for e-commerce brands.
About.body1: I create compelling videos that <customers>turn viewers into customers</customers>.
About.body2: <fiveYears>Five years ago</fiveYears>, I picked up a camera and started creating <ugc>UGC content</ugc>, filming myself, people, and the beauty around me — capturing emotions, stories, and fleeting moments through my lens. Over the years, I’ve mastered visual storytelling, playing with light, movement, and narrative to make every video feel alive and engaging.
About.body3: For the <twoYears>past two years</twoYears>, I’ve been fully dedicated to <aiCreation>AI video creation</aiCreation>, merging my deep background in production with cutting-edge artificial intelligence. This unique combination allows me to find fresh angles, build high-converting visuals, and convey atmosphere at a whole new level. As a video creator, I help brands create engaging, social-first content that genuinely connects with their audience. From AI commercials and product videos to UGC and lifestyle campaigns, I manage the entire creative process — from concept development and storyboarding to filming, AI generation, editing, and final delivery.

Faq.title: Questions before we start
Faq.intro: Clear answers for e-commerce teams planning AI commercials and ads.

turnaround.question: What is the typical turnaround time?
turnaround.answer: Starter projects deliver in <hl>3–5 business days</hl>. Growth & Commercial packages take <hl>6–10 business days</hl>. Retainer partners receive priority scheduling slots in my calendar.

product.question: Will the AI video accurately reflect my physical product?
product.answer: <hl>100% precision</hl>. I integrate high-res 3D or photo source files of your product into custom AI engines, ensuring complete visual realism without digital distortions.

ads.question: Can I run these videos as Meta, TikTok, and TV Ads?
ads.answer: Yes. You receive <hl>full commercial rights</hl> for all generated video & photo assets across all global digital advertising and broadcast channels.

revisions.question: How many revision rounds are included?
revisions.answer: Each project includes <hl>2 revision rounds</hl> covering video timing, color grading, sound design, and typography adjustments.

payment.question: How does payment and onboarding work?
payment.answer: I operate on a <hl>50% deposit</hl> to initiate production, with the remaining 50% due upon final approval and 4K asset delivery.
